तंस् {vI.v} {c1c} A. Ved. (तंसते)
1 To
shake.
--2 To pour out.
--3 To beg,
request. {vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (तंसति,
तंसयति-ते) To decorate.

तंक् {c1c} P. (तंकति, तंकित)
1 To
endure, bear.
--2 To laugh.
--3 To
live in distress.

तंकः [तंक् भावे अच्]
1 Living in
distress, a miserable life.
--2 Grief
produced by separation from a
beloved object.
--3 Fear, terror.
--4
A stone-cutter's chisel.
--5 A
garment.

तंकनं Living in distress,
miserable living.

तंग् {c1c} P. (तंगति, तंगित)
1 To go,
move.
--2 To shake, tremble.
--3
To stumble.

तंच् {vI.v} {c7c} P. (तनक्ति, तंचित) To
contract, shrink; तनच्मि व्योम विस्तृतं

1 A juggler, a
cheat.
--2 Froth, foam.
--3 A
wagtail.
--कः --कं
1 Complete
performance or preparation.
--2 Decoration.
--3 The upright post of a house.
--4
A composition abounding in
compounds.

1 A barbarian.
--2 A
fool, blockhead.
--3 Water in which
rice has been soaked.

तंडुलः [तंड्-उलच्] Grain after
threshing, unhusking and
winnowing; (especially rice); शस्य, धान्य,
तंडुल and अन्न are thus
distinguished from one another:--शस्यं क्षेत्रगतं
प्रोक्तं सतुषं धान्यमुच्यते । निस्तुषस्तंडुलः प्रोक्तः
स्विन्नमन्नमुदाहृतं ॥.
--Comp.
--अंबु n.
gruel.
--उत्थं-कं rice-gruel.
--ओघः
{1} a prickly sort of bamboo. {2} a
heap of grain.

तन्मय a. (यी f.)
1 Made up of
that.
--2 Wholly absorbed in that;

.
--3
Identical with, or become one with
that.

--2 To spread, shed, diffuse;

.

[]

confidence in.
--2 To help, assist,
aid.
--3 To pain or afflict with
disease.
--4 To be harmless.
--5 To
sound.

तानः [तन्-घञ्]
1 A thread, fibre.
--2 (In music) A protracted tone,
a key-note; यथा तानं विना रागः

. (the number of tānas is said to
[]
be 49).
--3 A monotonous tone.
--नं
1 Expanse, extension.
--2 An object
of sense.
--Comp.
--कर्मन् n. {1}

notes to catch the key.

anything.

तनिमन् m. [तनु-इमनिच्] Thinness,

तनिष्ठ a.

--2 Very
minute, or delicate (superl. of तनु
q. v.).

--2 Delicate,
slender, slim (as a limbs, as a mark

.

[]

character of anything.

. {3} rash,
